modules.name: Datum, epoch and CRS registry
modules.design_question: Which horizontal frame, vertical datum and epoch let City LiDAR, HRDEM/MRDEM, LidarBC, SRTM, footprints and cone heights agree to centimetres, with realisation, epoch, geoid and edition recorded for every layer?
modules.method: Canonical frame: EPSG:3157 and CGVD28GVRD as realised in City LiDAR (HTMVBC00, 1997-referenced per LTSA 465C). Tag every layer with horizontal realisation and epoch, vertical datum and epoch, geoid, edition. CGVD2013 layers (HRDEM, MRDEM, LidarBC): h(t) = H2013 + N_CGG2013an83; h(1997.0) = h(t) - v_up x (t - 1997.0) via ca_nrc_NAD83v70VG; H28 = h(1997.0) - N_HTMVBC00 (37.5 KB GeoBC BYN, GDAL -unscale, mask 9999). Map the epoch step over the AOI; cross-check with HT2_2010v70 minus HT2_1997. Primary acceptance: public GeoNetBC monuments (GOOD, VGV00, class A or B). Per layer, robust median of DTM minus monument H on hard flat ground, n at least 30, against the chain; if they differ by over 0.03 m, ship the measured offset with its standard error and log the gap. Diagnostics: NRCan GPS-H batch at the monuments; 2013 same-source bridge against both predicted residual grids (HTMVBC00, HT2); unconverted negative test. Fix signs with the EPSG 1126 example, h - N at CHS 07735 and CHS offsets. NTv2 EPSG:9119 for EPSG:26910 layers; assert not ballpark. Measure City 2022 versus COPC 2016 on 10+ roof corners. Cone tests compare geodetic H directly (M04); ask views@vancouver.ca for the cone datum.
inputs: HTMVBC00 BYN (GeoBC); PROJ-data grids CGG2013an83, CGG2013n83, HT2_1997, HT2_2002v70, HT2_2010v70 (and _CGG2013a), NAD83v70VG, BC_93_05, EGM96, EGM2008
BC GeoNetBC public monuments (WFS) and NRCan GPS-H web tool
LTSA Circular 465C (1997 epoch; Land Title Act s.138)
CHS station 07735 datum offsets and tidal heights
Public Views Guidelines s.2 'maximum geodetic height'; City answer on cone datum and curvature (pending)
outputs: datum registry JSON per layer (realisation, epoch, geoid, edition)
monument residual table per layer; epoch-step map; HTMVBC00-minus-HT2 map
unit tests: vgridshift sign, epoch sign, not-ballpark assertion
one-paragraph datum statement for the app

parameters.name: Z_2013 minus Z_28 and its sign
parameters.relationship: H = h - N gives Z_2013 - Z_28 = N_HT2 - N_CGG. EPSG 1126 subtracts a grid labelled 'HT2 minus CGG2013a', which reads as the opposite sign; a three-way test settles it. CHS implies +0.12 m; monument pilot +0.24 m.

parameters.name: Monument pilot offset (r3, 2026-10-21)
parameters.relationship: HRDEM mosaic DTM minus 27 GOOD downtown monuments (VGV00): median +0.240, mean +0.233, SD 0.099, SE 0.019 m; range +0.027 to +0.376. WMS 1 m pixel at each monument; mosaic source vintage unknown.

parameters.name: Epoch step
parameters.relationship: h(1997.0) = h(t) - v_up x (t - 1997.0). The 0.03 m tolerance is used up by 2.3 mm/yr over 13 years (2010 layers) or 1.2 mm/yr over 25.7 years (City 2022). v_up is not yet read from the grid.

parameters.name: Epoch of each model
parameters.relationship: LTSA 465C: HTMVBC00 and HTv2.0 (1997.0) are 1997-referenced; BC surveyors propagate to 1997.0 first. GPS-H: HTv2.0 is CGVD28-compatible only at 1997.0. CGG2013an83 is NAD83(CSRS)v6, epoch 2010.

parameters.name: HTMVBC00 local correction
parameters.relationship: delta = N_HTMVBC00 - N_HT2_1997 from the two grids; Z_28GVRD = Z_28(HTv2.0) - delta. GeoBC calls HTMVBC00 an enhanced HTv2.0. Magnitude not computed; the 37.5 KB BYN download needs team approval.

parameters.name: HT2 grid editions
parameters.relationship: PROJ-data HT2_2002v70 and HT2_2010v70 use the v7 velocity grid; GPS-H serves updates on v8.0. HT2_1997 is NAD83(CSRS)v2, epoch 1997. Record grid edition and sha256 per run.

parameters.name: Ellipsoidal vs orthometric
parameters.relationship: h = H + N; N differs by model (CGG2013a, HTMVBC00, EGM96, EGM2008), so heights from different models must not be mixed.

parameters.name: sigma_datum
parameters.relationship: sigma_datum = sqrt(s_monument^2 + s_epoch^2 + s_local^2), each measured (monument SE, epoch step, HTMVBC00 minus HT2). EPSG accuracy 0.0 for the 1997 variant is definitional; 2002 and 2010 list 0.02 and 0.03 m.

parameters.name: Monument sample size
parameters.relationship: SE of a median is about 1.25 x SD/sqrt(n). With SD 0.10 m, n = 30 gives 0.023 m and n = 90 gives 0.013 m, so the 0.03 m test needs at least 30 class A or B monuments (hand calculation).

parameters.name: UTM grid scale k
parameters.relationship: k = 0.999601 at the Vista anchor (E 491.2 km, computed); ground distance = grid distance / k, a 0.4 m/km shortening (12 m at 30 km).

parameters.name: Earth-curvature drop
parameters.relationship: drop = d^2/(2R) x (1 - k_ref): 1.96 m at 5.0 km, 2.04 m at 5.1 km (1.78 m with refraction 0.13), 70.6 m at 30 km. Line-of-sight rendering only, not cone tests (M04). Hand calculation, R = 6,371 km.

parameters.name: Water level in CGVD28
parameters.relationship: CHS 07735: MWL 3.06, HHWLT 5.01, LLWLT 0.06 m (chart datum assumed). CGVD28 offset -3.00 puts MWL at +0.06 m. Offsets carry no stated sign; recheck if the true shift is +0.24 m. Flatten water to a stated level.

parameters.name: MRDEM edition shift
parameters.relationship: v1.1 changed the datum transformation (about 40 cm average change); v1.2 fixed a 1 to 3 pixel offset where HRDEM is the source. GLO-30 was converted with CGG2013. Pin and record the edition.

parameters.name: NAD83 to NAD83(CSRS) in BC
parameters.relationship: EPSG:9119 NAD83 to NAD83(CSRS)v4 uses NTv2 BC_93_05 (accuracy 0.1, unit unstated). City orthophotos are labelled EPSG:26910; whether pixels are truly original NAD83 is unverified (test on roof corners).

parameters.name: Horizontal realisation offset
parameters.relationship: Mean planimetric offset of 10+ flat-roof corners, City 2022 (CSRS 4.0.0.BC.1.GVRD, epoch unstated) versus NRCan COPC 2016 (CSRS epoch 2010). Expected a few centimetres (unmeasured); flag above 0.15 m.

metrics.name: UTM tile-corner round trip
metrics.basis: City tile 490000_5459000 SW corner reproduces to 0.0003 m with an independent transverse Mercator (computed r1).

metrics.name: Layer offset versus GeoNetBC monuments (primary acceptance)
metrics.good: chain prediction matches the layer's monument median within 0.03 m, n at least 30 class A or B on hard ground
metrics.basis: Pilot: HRDEM mosaic minus 27 monuments is +0.240 m (SE 0.019) against CHS +0.12 m; the gap is four times the tolerance and is unexplained.

metrics.name: City DTM minus monument H on hard open ground
metrics.good: absolute median 0.05 m or less, n at least 30
metrics.basis: Tests the City's CGVD28GVRD label directly; City 2022 sensor accuracy is 0.081 m (95%). Not yet run (needs a City tile).

metrics.name: Same-source bridge (diagnostic): City DTM 2013 minus converted HRDEM 2013
metrics.good: median matches the chain NRCan used (HTMVBC00 or HT2) within 0.03 m; 95% spread reported separately
metrics.bad: absolute median above 0.06 m after conversion with either chain
metrics.basis: HRDEM Spec Ed. 1.7 gives no CGVD28 conversion method, so this tests NRCan's choice, not ours. Naive HRDEM minus City 2009 base elevation: median +0.70 m, robust sigma 0.58 m, unusable.

metrics.name: Negative test: unconverted HRDEM minus City DTM
metrics.good: median sits at the value predicted by the computed grids within 0.03 m (CHS prior +0.12 m; monument pilot +0.24 m)
metrics.bad: outside that band, or opposite sign
metrics.basis: r2 fixed +0.12 m from CHS alone; the r3 pilot reads +0.24 m, so the expected value now comes from grids. If it fails, the products do not share points; diagnose before applying any shift.

metrics.name: Epoch step reported and applied
metrics.good: s_epoch mapped over the AOI, applied to every CGVD2013 layer, and within 0.01 m of HT2_2010v70 minus HT2_1997
metrics.basis: LTSA 465C and GPS-H tie HTv2.0 and HTMVBC00 to 1997.0; CGVD2013 layers sit at 2010.

metrics.name: Sign tests agree
metrics.good: EPSG 1126 example (397.140 - 0.382 = 396.758), h - N at CHS 07735 and CHS offsets give one sign
metrics.basis: EPSG text and H = h - N appear to conflict; a unit test alone could encode the wrong expectation.

metrics.name: Layers carrying full datum tag
metrics.basis: Vista manifests state the model's vertical datum is unknown.

metrics.name: Transform accuracy known
metrics.good: every horizontal and vertical operation reports a stated accuracy of 0.1 m or better, and no EPSG 0.0 enters sigma_datum
metrics.basis: PROJ may apply a ballpark transformation without warning (r1 critique).

metrics.name: Horizontal offset City 2022 vs COPC 2016 on roof corners
metrics.good: mean offset 0.15 m or less
metrics.basis: Team threshold; corner picking has its own noise, so use the mean of 10 or more corners.

visualization: map of datum, realisation and epoch per layer with applied offsets
monument residual map and histogram per layer
map of HTMVBC00 minus HT2_1997 and of the epoch step over the AOI

modules.name: Footprint authority and conflation
modules.design_question: Which polygon represents each downtown building today, including post-2015 towers, with podium and tower parts separated, parcel-split polygons not mistaken for change, and displaced tower polygons caught?
modules.method: Core: (1) reproject City 2015 footprints (154,124 polygons) to EPSG:3157; (8) give every feature id, fp_source, fp_year, lidar_date, change flag; hand-trace the 15 tallest towers, including post-2015 ones, from LiDAR DSM hillshade; (10) offset check for every footprint with roof P90 above 30 m that is not hand-traced: share of building-class points inside the 0.5 m-shrunk polygon, and 2D offset between polygon centroid and building-point centroid; share under 0.8 or offset over 1 m means translate the polygon by the measured offset or add it to the hand-trace list. v1: (2) LiDAR building mask from City 2022 building-class returns more than 2.5 m above ground, 0.5 m raster; (3) split components where adjacent roof heights differ by more than 3 m; (4) match by one-sided coverage c_poly and c_part (nearest-polygon partition), IoU only for free-standing buildings; mask-only is new, polygon-only demolished, middling changed; (5) roofs 30 m or higher take regularised LiDAR outlines (simplify 0.25 to 0.5 m, snap within 5 degrees); (6) dissolve parcel-split polygons inside one mask part when roof P90 differs under 1 m; (7) OSM only as a separate optional overlay; Overture, Microsoft and City 2009 as cross-checks; (9) QA on DSM hillshade, test on tile 490000_5459000 first.
outputs: footprints in EPSG:3157 with provenance and change flags
offset-check flags and repair list for towers above 30 m
list of new, demolished and changed buildings (v1)
tower repair list (15 hand-traced towers in core)

parameters.name: Coverage classes
parameters.relationship: Kept if c_poly and c_part are both at least 0.8; changed between 0.3 and 0.8; mask-only is new; polygon-only is demolished. Team starting values to tune on tile 490000_5459000 (v1).

parameters.name: Offset-check thresholds (core)
parameters.relationship: Flag a roof above 30 m when building-point share inside the shrunk polygon is under 0.8 or centroid offset exceeds 1 m. Team starting values; tune on the fixture tile.

parameters.name: Mask height threshold
parameters.relationship: Building mask = building-class returns with z minus ground above 2.5 m (team choice).

parameters.name: Roof-height break
parameters.relationship: Split mask components where adjacent roof heights differ by more than 3 m so podiums and towers separate (team choice, tune on the fixture tile).

parameters.name: Parcel-split merge
parameters.relationship: City splits contiguous buildings at parcel lines; dissolve touching polygons inside one mask part when absolute p90 roof difference is below 1 m.

parameters.name: Simplification tolerance
parameters.relationship: Douglas-Peucker 0.25 to 0.5 m bounds added horizontal error; 2018 LiDAR horizontal accuracy is 0.36 m (95%).

parameters.name: Relief displacement
parameters.relationship: lean = h x tan(theta), theta the off-nadir angle: 150 m at 3 degrees leans 7.9 m (hand calculation). City orthophoto text covers camera tilt and terrain relief, not building lean.

metrics.name: Footprint IoU versus LiDAR roof mask, free-standing towers 50 m and taller
metrics.good: 0.85 or higher
metrics.basis: Team threshold for outline agreement before extrusion.

metrics.name: Core offset check: flagged towers resolved
metrics.good: every footprint with P90 above 30 m is passed, translated or hand-traced before heights are released
metrics.basis: Relief lean of several metres at 100 m or more can put 2015 polygons off the LiDAR roof, so P50 to P90 would mix street and podium points.

metrics.name: Parcel-split polygons wrongly flagged changed
metrics.good: 10% or less on tile 490000_5459000
metrics.basis: IoU against block-sized mask components would flag nearly every parcel polygon; coverage ratios should not (v1 step).

metrics.name: Post-2015 towers present
metrics.good: all top-10 towers present with correct outline (hand-traced in core)
metrics.basis: Wikipedia list shows Paradox 2016, One Burrard Place 2021, The Stack 2023, The Butterfly 2024, all after the 2015 footprints.

metrics.name: Footprint edge error versus roof edge
metrics.good: 0.5 m or less
metrics.basis: 2018 LiDAR horizontal accuracy 0.36 m (95%); City 2015 footprints stated as approximate.

visualization: footprint overlay on LiDAR DSM hillshade coloured by source, offset flag and change flag
coverage-ratio histograms (v1)
modules.limits: Core has no automated conflation. LiDAR mask merges touching buildings and canopy; City 2015 outlines are approximate; construction after Sept 2022 is invisible. The competition brief says context includes future approved 244 to 305 m towers that no dataset holds.
modules.effort: Core 0.75 person-day (reproject, provenance fields, 15 hand-traced towers, offset check); full 5 (team estimate).
modules.human_judgment: Decide whether OSM geometry is allowed (ODbL); choose the 15 towers to hand-trace; approve the 30 m LiDAR-outline rule for v1; decide how approved but unbuilt towers enter the context.

modules.name: LiDAR LOD1 height extraction
modules.design_question: How are robust roof and base heights derived per footprint from 49 points per square metre LiDAR, without neighbouring walls or noise inflating the maximum, and with towers finished after the survey flagged?
modules.method: Per footprint, assign City 2022 points by nearest-footprint partition (distance transform on the 0.25 m polygon-id raster: inside = 0, outside only within 0.5 m, nearest polygon wins), so a podium takes no wall returns of an adjacent tower. Read numeric LAS class codes from a tile header first. Building-class sample: points inside the polygon shrunk 0.5 m. max_bldg: building-class first returns after spike removal (z more than 5 MAD from the 1 m cell median). max_all: highest non-vegetation, non-water, non-noise return in the partition cell, counted only when at least 5 points lie within 1 m above max_bldg; Noise class goes to max_noise; band returns more than 3 m above max_bldg are listed, not counted. P50, P75, P90, P95, P99 from the building-class point population (3D BAG operator); label PDAL rasters 'P90 of 0.5 m cell maxima'. Ground = P10 of ground-class points in a 0.5 to 2 m ring, else DTM. Store roof elevation in the canonical datum, height above ground, n_roof, n_ground, n_above_bldg, flat-roof flag. Post-2022 towers (v1): difference against LidarBC 2025 (8 pts/m2, CGVD2013) and set built_after_lidar. Core: P90, max_bldg, max_all. Cone tests and the existing-tower regression use max_all (clause 3.1.1 counts appurtenances; 3.1.2 minor items go to review); display P90.
inputs: footprints and offset flags from C02-M02
outputs: per-building roof percentiles, max_bldg, max_all, max_noise, ground, quality fields
max_all gap and band-outlier list for manual review

parameters.name: Roof percentile q
parameters.relationship: h_roof(q) = P_q(z_roof) minus z_ground from the building-class point population; store p50, p75, p90, p95, p99. Display p90.

parameters.name: Two maxima and cluster rule
parameters.relationship: max_bldg = building-class first returns after the spike filter. max_all = highest non-vegetation, non-water, non-noise return in the partition cell, accepted with 5 or more points within 1 m above max_bldg; max_noise stored apart. Cone tests use max_all.

parameters.name: Partition rule
parameters.relationship: Each point goes to the nearest footprint (distance transform on the 0.25 m id raster; inside = 0; outside only within 0.5 m). Band returns over 3 m above max_bldg are listed, not counted (team starting values).

parameters.name: Ground reference
parameters.relationship: z_ground = P10 of ground points in a 0.5 to 2 m ring; 3D BAG uses percentiles 0 to 50 within a 0.5 m buffer.

parameters.name: Inner buffer
parameters.relationship: Shrink footprint 0.5 m before sampling roof points (team choice).

parameters.name: Minimum points
parameters.relationship: Require n_roof at least 100 and n_ground at least 20; mean density 49 points per square metre.

parameters.name: Height error budget
parameters.relationship: sigma_H = sqrt(sigma_lidar^2 + sigma_ground^2 + sigma_def^2). LiDAR 0.081 m (95%) is about 0.04 m at 1 sigma if Gaussian; sigma_ground and the published-height definition sigma_def are measured per building.

parameters.name: Block-fit RMSE benchmark (not height accuracy)
parameters.relationship: 3D BAG median RMSE between point cloud and extruded block, wall points included: 0.31 m flat roofs, 1.06 m non-flat; flat class median height about 2.5 m (sheds, garages).

parameters.name: Percentile operator
parameters.relationship: Percentile of cell maxima is not percentile of points; any benchmark applies to the point operator only.

metrics.name: Tower height error versus published (max_all, definition matched)
metrics.good: 1.0 m or less
metrics.basis: Error budget (LiDAR 0.081 m 95%, ground, roof definition), not the 3D BAG block-fit RMSE. Define the published reference (roof, architectural top, spire) per building; check City 2009 topelev and UBC bldgheight.

metrics.name: Neighbour-wall leakage on a synthetic podium
metrics.good: podium max_all within 0.3 m of the true roof beside a 150 m wall; Noise points excluded
metrics.bad: any podium max_all above the true roof by 1 m
metrics.basis: City 2015 polygons split at parcel lines, so a plain 0.5 m outward buffer would give podiums the tower's wall returns and the regression false exceedances.

metrics.name: Block-to-point fit RMSE (not height accuracy)
metrics.good: at most 0.31 m flat, 1.06 m non-flat
metrics.basis: 3D BAG medians on Dutch buildings; the RMSE counts wall points as well as roof points. Compare point percentiles only.

metrics.name: Points per footprint
metrics.good: n_roof 100 or more and n_ground 20 or more
metrics.basis: City 2022 mean density about 49 points per m2.

metrics.name: Unreviewed max_all excess over max_bldg
metrics.good: every tower with max_all more than 1 m above max_bldg has a reviewed cause (crane, spire, mast, noise)
metrics.bad: any unreviewed excess above 1 m on a tower
metrics.basis: Class rules and the spike filter can hide thin rooftop elements that clause 3.1.1 counts.

3D block over point cloud

Glass, thin spires, cranes and post-Sept-2022 tops distort heights. Partition fails if a polygon is displaced over a neighbour. PDAL needs conda-forge on Windows.

modules.name: Downtown ground surface and cone-height interface
modules.design_question: What is bare-earth elevation Z_ground(x,y) in CGVD28GVRD, and how does a cone-height surface H_cone(E,N) plug in, tested on synthetic cones, without implying a zoning height?
modules.method: Tile rule: 1 km tiles (SW-corner names) within 1.5 km of E 491221.8, N 5458890.0: 14 squares intersect but 492000_5460000 is not in the portal, so 13 (ring R0); within 2 km, 21 intersect and 20 are listed. Scripted GET returns 403: download in a browser (team approval), record size and sha256, process one tile at a time outside the repo, then delete the LAS. Ground-class points give 1 m DTM and DSM; TIN-fill under buildings; flatten water to the M01 level; treat bridges explicitly; check against 2018, 2013 and the monuments. Core: Z_ground(E,N) in CGVD28GVRD with sigma, published as a 2 m DTM or error-bounded mesh, plus a cone interface H_cone(E,N), a surface and never a scalar, tested on synthetic level and sloping cones. Real cone figures are out of core and labelled 'estimate' until the City confirms datum and curvature. v1: compare building max_all with H_cone at the same (E,N), no curvature terms (curvature is for line-of-sight rendering only); h_allow = H_cone minus Z_ground, labelled 'above 2022 bare earth, not the bylaw base surface'; origin Z = DTM + eye height (1.68 m, unverified); existing-tower regression.
inputs: datum offsets and water level from C02-M01
outputs: Z_ground(x,y) with sigma and the H_cone(E,N) interface with synthetic-cone tests

parameters.name: Cone test frame
parameters.relationship: Compare building H and cone H at the same (E,N), both geodetic heights in the canonical datum. No curvature or tangent-plane terms in compliance tests; curvature is for line-of-sight rendering only.

parameters.name: Cone surface type
parameters.relationship: H_cone is a surface H(E,N). Barclay snippets list 3.2.1 points from 123.2 to 143.4 m on one site, so a sloped lower boundary is plausible; one scalar per cone is wrong until the Guidelines are read.

parameters.name: Curvature convention unknown
parameters.relationship: A level surface at distance d sits d^2/(2R) below the tangent plane: 2.04 m at 5.1 km, 1.78 m with refraction. QE apex to an approximate Barclay point is 4.78 km: 1.79 m (1.56 m refracted). The City's convention is unknown.

parameters.name: Allowed height above ground
parameters.relationship: h_allow(x,y) = H_cone minus Z_ground(x,y), both in one vertical datum; a ground error moves the limit one-for-one.

parameters.name: Error budget
parameters.relationship: sigma_allow = sqrt(sigma_cone^2 + sigma_ground^2 + sigma_datum^2 + sigma_curv^2); LiDAR 0.081 m (95%) is about 0.04 m at 1 sigma. sigma_curv is up to about 2 m for ray-reconstructed cones until the City answers, 0 for published heights.

parameters.name: SRTM propagation
parameters.relationship: Delta h_allow = minus Delta Z_ground; SRTM actual vertical error about 10 m (16 m LE90 specification) gives a limit error of the same size.

parameters.name: Interpolation error
parameters.relationship: Linear interpolation error bound is (cell^2/8) x max second derivative; dense LiDAR keeps flat downtown error far below sensor noise.

parameters.name: Bylaw base surface vs LiDAR ground
parameters.relationship: Bylaw height is measured from a base surface built from official building grades at site corners (By-law 13067, search summary, unopened). LiDAR bare earth differs by an unquantified amount; never present h_allow as a zoning height.

parameters.name: View origin eye height
parameters.relationship: Origin Z = Z_ground + 1.68 m (average 5 ft 6 in viewer per a 2023 City memo, search summary only); unverified parameter.

metrics.name: DTM vertical error versus control
metrics.good: 0.1 m or less on open hard surface (GeoNetBC monuments as control)
metrics.basis: City sensor accuracy: 2022 is 0.081 m (95%), 2018 and 2013 are 0.18 m (95%).

metrics.name: Cone-interface unit tests on synthetic cones (core)
metrics.good: level plane and 5% sloping plane reproduce H_cone(E,N) within 0.01 m at 100 random points
metrics.basis: Core cannot use real cone heights; the interface is proven on known surfaces and carries 'estimate' on every real figure.

metrics.name: Allowed-height uncertainty sigma_allow
metrics.good: 0.25 m or less
metrics.basis: Team tolerance; datum and cone height dominate LiDAR noise. While curvature is unresolved, ray-reconstructed cones carry about 2 m, so this target is not met for them.

metrics.name: Existing-tower regression against reconstructed cones (max_all) (v1)
metrics.good: every pre-amendment tower at or below H_cone, or on a documented exception list
metrics.basis: Needs real cone heights, so it is v1. Guards against datum, curvature or height errors before any compliance wording; max_all so thin rooftop items count.

metrics.name: Level-cone curvature unit test
metrics.good: a level surface at 5.1 km in ENU sits 2.04 m below the tangent plane within 0.01 m
metrics.bad: no test, or error above 0.05 m
metrics.basis: Hand calculation d^2/(2R), R = 6,371 km; guards against flat-plane cone reconstruction.

metrics.name: Vista SRTM baseline terrain error
metrics.good: not applicable
metrics.bad: about 10 m typical, 16 m LE90 specification
metrics.basis: USGS statement on SRTM; Vista samples SRTM at 60 m with EGM96 heights.

visualization: hillshade of 1 m DTM
difference map City DTM minus SRTM 60 m
absolute cone-elevation surface with sigma under one synthetic cone
modules.limits: Ground under buildings is interpolated. Real cone elevations depend on the unconfirmed datum, curvature convention and Guidelines text. The 2022 surface shows 2022 grade. Bridges need explicit treatment. 20 tiles may total 10 to 25 GB (estimate).
modules.effort: Core 1.0 person-day (City DTM from the fixture and R0 tiles, Z_ground with sigma, synthetic-cone interface); full 5.5 (team estimate).
modules.human_judgment: Approve interpolation under buildings and treatment of bridges, fill and water; approve the 'estimate' wording until the City answers; approve synthetic cones in place of real ones for core.

modules.name: Multi-resolution terrain and North Shore backdrop
modules.design_question: How should terrain be tiered from 1 m downtown to 30 m mountains 10 to 50 km away, given that open 1 m LiDAR does not reach the North Shore peaks?
modules.method: Measure coverage first. Read the MRDEM-30-SOURCE asset (STAC source; 10 HRDEM mosaic, 5 blended, 1 adjusted GLO-30) over the AOI; compare HRDEM extent polygons, mosaic point queries and the LidarBC point-cloud index. 1 m LiDAR reaches the lower slopes to about 49.38 N, a valley strip east of Grouse (2016) and western strips (2019, 2024), not the Grouse or Seymour summit samples or the Lions. Rings: R0 0 to 1.5 km, City DTM 1 m. R1 1.5 to 6 km: City LiDAR to its 49.32 N limit, then LidarBC or HRDEM 1 m where a tile exists, resampled to 2 to 5 m (v1; core uses MRDEM-30). R2 6 to 25 km: 1 m LiDAR resampled to 10 m where covered, else MRDEM-30 at native 30 m (never upsample). R3 25 to 50 km: MRDEM-30. DTM for ground, DSM for skylines; canopy separate. Convert every ring via M01; calibrate offsets on overlaps. Mesh with Delatin or RTIN under error epsilon(d) = tau x d x HFOV/width; share boundary vertices or add skirts; curvature at render time. Check skylines against surveyed peak points (GeoNetBC) and local-search maxima. Request ridge LiDAR from LidarBC, Metro Vancouver, North and West Vancouver.

modules.name: Accuracy audit versus Vista and published heights
modules.design_question: How far do LiDAR-derived heights and terrain differ from Vista's OSM and SRTM context once Vista's distorted frame is corrected, and do they reproduce published checks?
modules.method: Define a regression set run in EPSG:3157. (a) About 40 downtown towers with published heights. (b) 20 or more UBC buildings with ubcv_Structures bldgheight (2021 LiDAR). (c) 200 random downtown buildings, LiDAR height versus Vista height, after re-projecting Vista geometry with the documented transform (Vista formula, then lon/lat; local ENU for the Vista own error, UTM for exchange). (d) 500 terrain points, Vista SRTM 60 m surface versus City DTM after datum calibration; also the z shifts Vista applied when re-seating buildings. (e) Cone-flip analysis: per protected view, count buildings whose cone-intersection status changes when OSM heights are replaced by LiDAR heights, using test H_cone values. (f) Existing-tower regression against reconstructed cones (M04, max_all). Report median, p95 and maximum absolute error by tier, with maps and histograms. Run the numbers in CI on fixture tile 490000_5459000. Publish an accuracy statement beside the data. Vista facts: central model 9,897 buildings (1,441 measured OSM heights, 3,656 from levels, 4,800 estimated); extension 51,510 from current OSM; local frame uses 110,574 m per degree of latitude. Moved to v1 in r2; the 5-tower smoke check sits in M03.

modules.name: Currency, provenance and licence manifest
modules.design_question: How are building currency, attribution, licence obligations and the source of every value tracked per layer so the open-source release stays compliant and free of unsourced numbers?
modules.method: Maintain layers.json with id, publisher, URL, retrieval date, upstream modified date, licence, attribution text, CRS, realisation, epoch, vertical datum, edition (for example MRDEM 1.2), acquisition date and checksum. Generate in-app credits and README attribution from it. Provenance rule: every geometry, height, elevation or override cites a dataset id plus checksum, or a document plus page; CI rejects untraceable values, so nothing written by a language model (including GPT-6 Astra) enters layers. Default attributions: City layers 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Vancouver' with a link to opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/ (City text unread); provincial layers 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – British Columbia.'; NRCan layers 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.' Credit Copernicus for MRDEM and GLO-30. Keep ODbL layers (OSM, Overture) in a separate database; no OSM geometry in City-derived products without a licence opinion. Flag buildings completed after City LiDAR (7 and 9 Sept 2022) via LidarBC 2025 differencing (v1) and a cited override table (The Stack 2023, The Butterfly 2024). Re-pull view cones when the portal modified date changes and diff by view_number (r3 diff: 24 of 24 identical). GeoNetBC monuments: QA only; publish summary statistics.

validation_cases.input: CHS station 07735 (49.2863, -123.0997): offsets CGVD2013 -2.88, CGVD28 -3.00; MWL 3.06 m. HT2_1997 and HT2_2010v70 variants, the HTMVBC00 chain and NRCan GPS-H (Input H, HT2_1997 to CGG2013a) at the same point.
validation_cases.expected: CHS implies Z_2013 - Z_28 = +0.12 m (sign inferred). The r3 monument pilot reads +0.24 m. Grids and GPS-H settle both the sign and the size; the unit test follows them.

validation_cases.input: City DEM 2013 (CGVD28) versus HRDEM VILLE_VANCOUVER 2013 DTM (CGVD2013) at 200 hard open-ground points; then the HTMVBC00 chain and the HT2 chain at the same points.
validation_cases.expected: Unconverted median equals the grid-predicted value within 0.03 m; after conversion the median is at most 0.03 m for the chain NRCan used. Whichever chain fits tells how NRCan converted the 2013 data.

validation_cases.input: HRDEM mosaic WMS GetFeatureInfo, layers dsm and dtm, EPSG:4326, at (49.2858886,-123.1238138) and (49.2857295,-123.1237864); City 2009 rows bldgid 149845; published 200.9 m.
validation_cases.expected: r1 read DSM 220.72 and 227.84 m over DTM 30.75 and 30.87 m (CGVD2013), so 190 to 197 m above ground. City 2009: topelev 219.29 and 223.71 over base 30.70 and 30.76. 2022 LiDAR max_all minus ground should be about 195 to 201 m.

validation_cases.case: Towers completed after the City LiDAR
validation_cases.input: Footprints of The Stack (2023) and The Butterfly (2024); City 2022 LiDAR (7 and 9 Sep 2022) versus a LidarBC 2025 tile covering the site.

validation_cases.input: Synthetic 20 m podium polygon abutting a 150 m tower wall; 49 pts/m2 on roofs, wall returns, 30 Noise-class points at 160 m, a 4 m mast cluster of 50 points on the podium, 3 stray points 6 m above the roof.
validation_cases.expected: Podium max_all within 0.3 m of 20 m plus the mast; tower wall returns go to the tower; Noise only in max_noise; the 3 stray points do not count (cluster rule needs 5); band outliers listed.

validation_cases.input: Synthetic 150 m tower, roof points offset 7.9 m from the City polygon (150 x tan 3 degrees = 7.86 m); building-class points otherwise exact.
validation_cases.expected: Building-point share inside the shrunk polygon falls below 0.8 and centroid offset reads about 7.9 m, so the tower is flagged and either translated by the measured offset or hand-traced.

validation_cases.case: Percentile and dual-maximum recovery on synthetic roof
validation_cases.input: Synthetic 30 x 30 m flat roof at 150 m, 49 points per m2, Gaussian noise 0.08 m, wall points, 20 spikes, plus a 4 m mast of 50 points classed Unclassified.
validation_cases.expected: P90, P95 and max_bldg within 0.3 m of 150 m from the point population; max_all reports about 154 m with n_above_bldg 50; also report the cell-maxima operator and its bias.

flags.claim: Google Open Buildings can supply Vancouver footprints.
flags.correction: Coverage is Africa, South and South-East Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean; Canada is not listed and the page names no height field.
flags.detail: Use City LiDAR, City 2015 footprints, OSM, Overture or Microsoft instead.

flags.claim: City building-footprint datasets carry height fields.
flags.correction: Only the 2009 set has elevations and heights, as roof-facet rows under 2009 conditions; 2015 and 1999 sets are geometry only.
flags.detail: 2009 rows near Shangri-La show a tower under construction; do not treat them as current.

flags.claim: The City publishes DEM or DSM products derived from 2018 and 2022 LiDAR.
flags.correction: 2018 and 2022 are zipped LAS tiles only; the only City raster DEM is the 2013 1 m GeoTIFF (1.91 GB).
flags.detail: We must derive DTM and DSM ourselves (M04).

flags.claim: EPSG:26910 is NAD83(CSRS) UTM zone 10N.
flags.correction: 26910 is NAD83 (original); NAD83(CSRS) / UTM 10N is EPSG:3157. City LiDAR states NAD83(CSRS) 4.0.0.BC.1.GVRD.
flags.detail: EPSG remarks say sub-metre accuracy needs the CSRS code; City orthophotos are labelled EPSG:26910.

flags.claim: All elevation sources can be merged without datum work.
flags.correction: City LiDAR is CGVD28GVRD; HRDEM and MRDEM are CGVD2013; SRTM is EGM96; GLO-30 is EGM2008; OSM heights are relative.
flags.detail: CHS offsets imply about +0.12 m between CGVD2013 and CGVD28 (unverified); the r3 monument pilot reads +0.24 m; MRDEM v1.1 moved heights about 0.4 m.

flags.claim: Vista README: terrain is '60 m SRTM'.
flags.correction: SRTM 1 arc-second (about 30.9 x 20.1 m cells) sampled at 60 m (extension) and 300 m (backdrop), EGM96; supplied-model terrain source and datum are unrecorded.
flags.detail: Actual vertical error is about 10 m (USGS), unusable for cone height limits.

flags.claim: Vista's local equirectangular frame is adequate for cone tests.
flags.correction: It differs from UTM 10N by about 5 m at 2.5 km and up to 34 m at its extent corners (computed).
flags.detail: Fine for visuals; use geodetic H comparison or a per-view ENU frame for geometry that touches cone edges. r2: Vista's own error against true-north ENU is in the r2 flag below.

flags.claim: Cone maximum geodetic heights are in CGVD28(GVRD).
flags.detail: LTSA 465C (read r3) keeps CGVD28 approved and defines 'geodetic elevation' for the Land Title Act (s.138), which supports but does not prove the choice for the Guidelines (s.2 p.3). Guidelines datum text still unread (403). Ask views@vancouver.ca.

flags.claim: View 3.2.1 is 123.201 m geodetic (Barclay).
flags.detail: r3 correction: 3.2.1 is 1989 and unamended (Table 1); 12.1.1 is absent from the 24 current references, so the Barclay figures use pre-2024 numbering. Snippets give 3.2.1 points 123.2 to 143.4 m; 361 ft has unknown definition. PDFs unopened (403).

flags.claim: City OGL-Vancouver and OSM ODbL layers can be combined in one release.
flags.detail: r1: OGL-Vancouver is reported as OGL-BC 2.0 (attribution only), but the City text is unread and a 2014 post records a negative City answer on ODbL compatibility; ODbL share-alike remains. Keep layers separate pending a legal opinion.

flags.claim: 2022 LiDAR is current for every downtown tower.
flags.correction: Acquisition was 7 and 9 Sept 2022; The Stack (2023) and The Butterfly (2024) post-date it.
flags.detail: Flag built_after_lidar and use a cited override table; LidarBC 2025 tiles can confirm. The competition brief also says context includes future approved towers.

flags.claim: NRCan Automatically Extracted Buildings has usable heights for Vancouver.
flags.detail: Feature catalogue lists Height Maximum/Minimum, but a WMS GetFeatureInfo query downtown returned empty; coverage unconfirmed.

flags.claim: LidarBC datum and licence are known.
flags.detail: r1: 2025 tiles state CGVD2013(2010); 2016 index field is blank; licence is OGL-BC in the portal record but 'Access Only' in the catalogue field. r2: the 2024 tiles in the index also list CGVD2013. Still conflicting on licence.

flags.claim: SRTM is adequate for 'as accurate as possible' North Shore mountains.
flags.correction: MRDEM-30 (HRDEM-derived 1.04 to 2.55 m RMSE vs RTK; GLO-30-derived 1.59 to 4.99 m vs HRDEM DTM, spec Table 2) is available over the same area; SRTM is about 10 m.
flags.detail: Slopes amplify horizontal error (20 m CE90 on 30 degrees gives 11.5 m vertical). HRDEM 1 m does not reach the ridges (r1).

flags.claim: City LiDAR class names map to LAS codes 1 to 8.
flags.detail: The portal lists class names as a numbered list; ASPRS codes differ (for example water is 9, noise 7). Read the LAS header or a class histogram first; r3 portal re-read confirms names only.

flags.claim: HRDEM BC-Lower_Mainland_2016-1m (bbox to 49.5125 N) gives 1 m terrain and skyline for the North Shore front ranges (M05 R2).
flags.correction: A bbox is an envelope. The extent polygon (351 vertices, 2 parts) excludes Grouse, Seymour, Crown, Cypress, Lions samples; HRDEM mosaic DTM is null at Grouse and Seymour; LidarBC has no point-cloud tile there. Ridge terrain is MRDEM-30, GLO-30-derived.
flags.detail: Measured r1: 25% of a 0.02 degree grid north of 49.38 N lies in any LidarBC tile (2016 5%, 2019 15%, 2025 0%). r2 correction: the third year is 2024 (about 5%, inferred), not 2025. Sample coordinates approximate. LidarBC lists 1 m DEM sheets over the peaks; contents untested.

flags.claim: City LiDAR 2022 heights use the HTGVRDBC00 hybrid geoid.
flags.correction: Portal metadata names the Metro Vancouver Geoid HTMVBC00 (HTMVBC00_Abbbyn.zip). GeoBC: HTMVBC00 equals HTGVRDBC00 extended east to Abbotsford; LTSA approves HTGVRDBC00 in Metro Vancouver.
flags.detail: Registry records HTMVBC00 and epoch 1997. PROJ grid epoch 2010 differs from this; use HT2_1997 variant as primary and quantify locally.

flags.claim: Vista's frame differs from UTM by about 5 m at 2.5 km; a generic projection effect, fine for visuals.
flags.correction: Cause is a wrong latitude constant (110,574 vs 111,215.2 m/deg, 0.58% short) plus 0.19% short longitude scale. Offsets reach 21 m at the north edge of the supplied model and 34 m at the SE corner; 14 m at 2.5 km north.
flags.detail: The supplied Rhino model fits the formula to 0.08 m, so it carries the distortion. Re-project Vista assets with a documented forward and inverse transform.

flags.claim: OGL-Vancouver may be 'viral' (share-alike), so City layers cannot be combined (M08).
flags.correction: The 2011 commentary predates the current licence. OGL-Vancouver is reported as OGL-BC 2.0 with the name replaced; the OGL-BC 2.0 text read is attribution-only. Share-alike comes from ODbL.
flags.detail: City's own text and attribution string still unread; keep OSM and Overture separate regardless.

flags.claim: 13 City LiDAR 2022 tiles lie within 2 km of downtown.
flags.correction: 20 tiles intersect a 2 km circle around the Vista anchor; 13 intersect a 1.5 km circle. Plain scripted requests get HTTP 403.
flags.detail: Tile list and rule are in M04 and validation cases; one tile measured 1.007 GB. r2: geometric counts are 14 and 21; 492000_5460000 is absent from the portal.

flags.claim: MRDEM Table 2 accuracy values (1.04/1.69, 2.55/4.17, GLO-30-derived 1.59 and 4.99 m).
flags.detail: Resolved r2: table read from the local PDF text. HRDEM-derived DTM vs RTK 1.04/1.69 non-vegetated, 2.55/4.17 vegetated; GLO-30-derived DTM vs HRDEM DTM (not RTK) 1.59/2.60 and 4.99/8.07. No ridge-specific accuracy; Seymour DSM peak is 15.5 to 16.4 m low versus the r3 surveyed point.

flags.claim: LidarBC 1 m DEM sheets 092g035, 092g036, 092g045 contain ridge data.
flags.detail: The DEM index lists them over the Grouse, Seymour and West Lion samples, but the point-cloud index has no tile there and 17 to 24 of 64 sub-tiles are missing per sheet. Read pixels to settle.

flags.claim: City LiDAR zips cannot be fetched by script.
flags.detail: Default clients get 403; a HEAD with browser User-Agent and portal Referer returned 200 (size only, nothing downloaded). Terms for automated access unknown; plan browser downloads or ask the City.

flags.claim: City orthophotos labelled EPSG:26910 are in original NAD83.
flags.detail: They may be NAD83(CSRS) mislabelled; original NAD83 differs by up to about 1 m in BC. Test on LiDAR roof corners before applying EPSG:9119.

flags.claim: A 14 person-day core fits before 13 Nov 2026.
flags.correction: r3 core is about 7.75 person-days (6.75 plus 1.0 contingency): M01 1.25, M02 0.75, M03 2.25, M04 1.0, M05 0.5, M06 0.5, M08 0.5. Full packet about 40. Cut line: if the datum chain is not green by day 3, ship City-only CGVD28GVRD terrain and buildings.
flags.detail: 17 working days to 13 Nov (including today, excluding 11 Nov) for 2 students at an assumed 40% share is about 13.6 person-days for all packets; C02 core takes about 57% of that. M07, conflation and LidarBC differencing are v1.

flags.claim: If view 3.2.1 is 123.201 m geodetic (Barclay), 361 ft at Thurlow/Haro implies City DTM there is about 13 m +/- 1 m.
flags.correction: The two values come from different sites and possibly different editions, and it is unknown whether 361 ft is above grade. HRDEM DTM near 1045 Haro is about 40.7 m, not 13 m.
flags.detail: Inference deleted. r2 WMS read 40.75 m at (49.2853,-123.1275) (critique: 40.65 m). 361 ft (110.03 m) stays an unverified figure of unknown definition; compare only same-site, same-edition values.

flags.claim: The 3D BAG median RMSE (0.31 m flat, 1.06 m non-flat) is a benchmark for tower height error versus published heights.
flags.correction: It is the point-cloud-to-block geometric difference including wall points: a block-fit metric, not height accuracy. Its flat class has about 2.5 m median height (sheds, garages).
flags.detail: Dukai et al. 2019 s.3.2 and Table 1 read in r2. Height accuracy now rests on an error budget (LiDAR 0.081 m 95%, ground, roof definition) checked against City 2009 and UBC references.

flags.claim: The local difference between HTMVBC00 and national HTv2.0 is unquantifiable because HTMVBC00 is not in PROJ.
flags.correction: GeoBC publishes HTMVBC00 as a 37.5 KB BYN and GDAL reads BYN, so the difference is computable and HTMVBC00 can be used directly in the chain.
flags.detail: PROJ-data holds ca_nrc_HT2_1997 and CGG2013a grids; map HTMVBC00 minus HT2_1997 over the AOI. Not yet computed: the download awaits team approval.

flags.claim: A City-DTM-minus-converted-HRDEM median of 0.15 m or less demonstrates correct datum handling.
flags.correction: The expected CGVD2013-CGVD28 shift is about 0.12 m, so an unconverted layer also passes. Require 0.03 m or less on hard surfaces, plus a negative test on the unconverted data.
flags.detail: CHS offsets imply +0.12 m; EPSG grid accuracies are 0.02 to 0.05 m; a reversed sign would give about 0.24 m.

flags.claim: Offsets between Vista and UTM grid coordinates measure Vista's own frame distortion.
flags.correction: They include UTM grid convergence (-0.0915 deg at the anchor: 6.3 m of easting over 3.94 km due north) and scale 0.9996. Against local true-north ENU the error at (0,3940) is E 0.0, N +22.9 m.
flags.detail: r2 computed: SE corner (5674,-5083) is 31.1 m in ENU versus 34.0 m in UTM. Report ENU for Vista's error; keep UTM offsets only for data exchange.

flags.claim: Roof maximum from building-class first returns after a spike filter is the conservative maximum for cone tests.
flags.correction: Appurtenances, masts and spires may be classed Unclassified, Other or Noise, and the spike filter removes thin elements that clause 3.1.1 counts. Store max_all (unfiltered, non-vegetation, non-water) and use it.
flags.detail: Class codes unread; cranes present in Sept 2022 push the other way. List max_all gaps for manual review. r3 refines max_all with partition, noise exclusion and a cluster rule.

flags.claim: The City's cone elevations include or omit Earth curvature and refraction.
flags.detail: Guidelines s.2 p.3 give a horizontal lower boundary with a maximum geodetic height; nothing on curvature in the extract. A level surface sits 2.04 m below the tangent plane at 5.1 km (1.79 m at the real QE to Barclay distance). Compare geodetic H directly; ask views@vancouver.ca.

flags.claim: View 3.2.1 on the Barclay site has one maximum geodetic height.
flags.detail: Search snippets show 3.2.1 points from 123.2 to about 143.4 m on one site (PDF unopened, 403), which conflicts with a single horizontal lower boundary (s.2 p.3). A sloped 1989-style boundary may explain it; read the PDF in a browser.

flags.claim: HTMVBC00 licence, epoch and BYN header details are known.
flags.detail: r3: LTSA 465C states HTGVRDBC00 is referenced to the 1997 epoch; the GeoBC page still states no licence, accuracy or epoch; header Factor, units and CRS unread. NRCan HT2 grids are OGL-Canada and NGA EGM Public Domain. Ask GeoBC before redistributing any derived grid.

flags.claim: HTMVBC00 and CGG2013a can be combined as H28 = H2013 + N_CGG2013a - N_HTMVBC00 through one ellipsoidal height, with epoch mixing only a residual note.
flags.correction: Add an NAD83(CSRS) velocity step from the layer epoch to 1997.0 (ca_nrc_NAD83v70VG) before applying N_HTMVBC00; report its size over the AOI; record horizontal and vertical epochs as separate registry fields.
flags.detail: LTSA 465C p.2: HTGVRDBC00 is referenced to the 1997 epoch and CSRS-PPP propagates to 1997.0 first. GPS-H: HTv2.0 is CGVD28-compatible only at 1997.0. CGG2013an83 and CGVD2013 layers sit at epoch 2010.

flags.claim: City DTM minus converted HRDEM within 0.03 m demonstrates that the team's HTMVBC00 chain is correct.
flags.correction: Treat the 2013 bridge as a diagnostic showing which model NRCan used. Accept the chain against GeoNetBC monuments, with both predicted residual grids (HTMVBC00 and HT2) computed.
flags.detail: HRDEM Spec Ed. 1.7 s.6.2 and 7.2 give no CGVD28 conversion method; STAC and the extent GeoJSON carry no vertical fields. The r3 monument pilot reads +0.24 m against the +0.12 m expectation.

flags.claim: View 3.2.1 was amended in 2024, so the Barclay edition and datum may differ.
flags.correction: 3.2.1 is unchanged since 1989. 12.1.1 is absent from the 24 current references, so the Barclay document uses the pre-2024 numbering.

flags.claim: EPSG method 1126 text and H = h - N agree on the sign of the HT2-minus-CGG2013a grid.
flags.detail: EPSG: A = HT2 minus CGG2013a, H_target = H_source - A. With H = h - N the physical shift is +(N_HT2 - N_CGG), the opposite. One label is inverted or N is defined with the other sign; test with the real grids at CHS 07735 and GPS-H.

flags.claim: The CGVD2013 to CGVD28GVRD offset downtown is about +0.12 m.
flags.detail: r3 pilot: HRDEM mosaic DTM minus 27 GOOD VGV00 monuments is +0.240 m (SD 0.099, SE 0.019), twice the CHS-based figure. Mosaic vintage, marker-versus-pavement bias and the VGV00 meaning (inferred CGVD28GVRD) are unverified; about 0.12 m is unexplained.

flags.claim: The GeoNetBC public monument layer can be used and shared freely.
flags.detail: Catalogue licence 'Access Only', isopen false; GEOID_UNDULATION is null on all queried features; VGV00 and GVD08 are not defined in the record; quality varies (A 2, B 72, C 18). Use for QA, publish summaries only, and ask GeoBC.

flags.claim: City LiDAR ellipsoidal heights are at epoch 1997.0 (consistent with HTMVBC00).
flags.detail: NAD83(CSRS) 4.0.0.BC.1.GVRD gives no epoch; 'v4' matches the 2002.0 variant in PROJ-data naming (HT2_2002v70). If heights are tied to Metro Vancouver control they are effectively static in the 1997 system. Inference only.

flags.claim: A local-maximum search within 15 m of the published peak height is achievable on 30 m MRDEM cells.
flags.correction: Measured at Seymour: DSM 15.5 m and window maximum 16.4 m below the surveyed monument (1,452.74 m CVD28, class C). Threshold relaxed to 20 m.
flags.detail: 30 m cells smooth summits; the check is a sanity bound, not an accuracy claim. West Lion has no monument.
